messages:
lee (New Hire): hey team, starting from berlin next Monday. quick questions: 1) i have a question about health insurance 12 public vs private here in germany, can redwood offer private supplemental cover? 2) i paid for a courier to ship work laptop cross-border 12 can i get reimbursed including VAT? 3) how is holiday accrual handled if you join mid-month?
marta (People Ops): welcome lee! :wave: short answers: we offer a supplemental private plan in DE for certain roles (opt-in) in addition to gesetzliche Krankenversicherung. i'll ping benefits. for expenses please upload invoices to the HR portal and set category "relocation/shipping" and include the VAT invoice; payroll can reimburse gross amounts where allowed. holiday is prorated based on company policy (calculated from your start date to year-end).
aditi (Benefits): hi lee 12 in germany we don't replace public insurance; employees on statutory health insurance can opt into our supplemental package if eligible. please fill the DE benefits form (i'll DM). for supplemental plan opt-in we need signed consent and copy of your insurance card.
lee (New Hire): thanks. uploaded files: courier_invoice_vat.pdf and customs_receipt.jpg to HR portal, set ticket note "VAT reclaim?"
hr-portal-bot: Upload received: courier_invoice_vat.pdf, customs_receipt.jpg. Created ticket HR-EXP-2042. Please add employee-id and bank last 4 digits to speed reimbursement.
mike (Payroll): saw HR-EXP-2042. We can reimburse shipping including VAT for work equipment if invoice is in company name or you assigned it via expense declaration. If invoice is personal, we'll reimburse net and provide a VAT reclaim guide. If approved before payroll cutoff (Thu 14:00 CET) it will appear in next cycle; otherwise the following one. Holiday: pro-rate calculation done in payroll system and will be shown on first payslip.
lee (New Hire): perfect. one more: if i opt into supplemental plan, will deductions start immediately or from next month?
aditi (Benefits): deductions start from the payroll cycle after coverage effective date; coverage effective date depends on when you complete the consent and we confirm with the insurer (usually start of next month). i'll DM you the DE form and next steps.
marta (People Ops): i'll mark HR-EXP-2042 for priority and DM the DE benefits form. welcome aboard and see you in the berlin office! :tada:
